title: Ts Rs Typegen Driver Retarget To Owner Root Generated
description:
This is step M8 of the "mechanism wave" (W4) in the approved plan `/Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-codebase-still-has-spicy-umbrella.md` — read it in full first, especially "Mechanism changes" Step 8 and the "Architecture risks" note "ts-rs export_to retargeting must land with the driver change" and Top-risk/blast-radius note "Step 8 wrong path = silent type drift".

CONTEXT — read in full, in this order:
1. The spicy-umbrella plan file above.
2. `.🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️master.md` — read in FULL for current state. Note especially: `🧰️framework/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📜️script.ts` was already fixed earlier this initiative to write its ts-rs output to `join(root, "..", "🟦️typescript", "generated", "manifest.ts")` (search "generatedManifestPath") — that fix is for the OLD sandwich layout (`⚡️implementations/🦀️rust` + sibling `⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript`) and will itself need to change once/if the framework-core crate moves to the new `📦️packages/<lang>` shape (which hasn't happened yet — framework consolidation is a LATER wave, W8). Your job right now is narrower: retarget the ts-rs DRIVER's output path convention to the NEW `<owner>/🤖️generated/🟦️manifest.ts` shape (per the plan) for whichever crates have ALREADY moved to the new shape (i.e. plugin crates, all 32 + demonstrator, if any of them use ts-rs export_to at all — check first; most plugin crates likely don't use ts-rs directly, in which case this ticket may find its primary real target is elsewhere).
3. Search the repo for every ts-rs `#[derive(TS)]` / `export_to` usage (`grep -rn "export_to\|derive(TS)" --include="*.rs"`) to find every crate that actually uses ts-rs codegen — this tells you the REAL scope, don't assume from the plan's prose alone.
4. `framework-core-rs:check` and `ui-wgpu-rs:check` targets (mentioned in the plan as needing to retarget "same commit") — find these project.json targets and understand what they currently check.

YOUR TASK: for every crate that uses ts-rs codegen AND has already moved to the new `📦️packages/<lang>` shape, retarget its ts-rs driver/build.rs to write to `<owner-root>/🤖️generated/🟦️manifest.ts` (or the crate-appropriate generated filename) instead of whatever old-shape-relative path it currently uses. Update the corresponding `*-rs:check`/`*-rs:generate` project.json targets in the SAME change (never leave the driver and its check target pointing at different paths, even transiently — this is exactly the "silent type drift" risk the plan warns about). If NO ts-rs-using crate has actually moved to the new shape yet (framework crates haven't migrated, and plugins mostly don't use ts-rs directly), say so explicitly in your close-out summary and describe what you verified to reach that conclusion — do not fabricate a change against something that isn't actually affected yet.

VERIFICATION: for whatever crate(s) you touch, run its `generate`/`check` targets before and after — confirm the generated TS file's CONTENT is byte-identical (or, if the crate itself is unchanged, that the codegen driver just successfully points at the new path and produces the SAME file content, just at a new location), and confirm no import site elsewhere in the TS codebase breaks (grep for imports of the old generated path and update them in lockstep if any exist).

CONSTRAINTS (non-negotiable):
- Never touch root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, nx.json, package.json workspaces, .storybook, .dependency-cruiser.cjs, the registry script/generated output, .vscode/launch.json, or any plugin/framework directory beyond the narrow ts-rs driver + its check target + downstream import-site fixes described above.
- Never run git-modifying commands or use git worktrees.
- Do NOT use `run_in_background: true` for Bash — run synchronously with generous timeouts.
- Add temporary files to your own ticket folder.
- When finished, call `mcp__repo__ticket_close` on your own ticket's exact path with a full summary (what you found the real scope to be, what you changed or explicitly deferred and why) and file list. Do not touch any other ticket.

Report back a concise summary of what ts-rs codegen sites actually exist in the repo today, what you changed, and your verification results.
summary:
NO CODE CHANGES MADE — real scope investigation found nothing eligible to retarget yet; this is the correct conclusion per the ticket's own instructions, not a stall.

**Full repo-wide ts-rs inventory** (`grep -rn "export_to\|derive(TS)\|derive(ts_rs::TS)" --include="*.rs" .`, plus a follow-up scan of every Cargo.toml for `ts-rs`/`ts_rs`, excluding `/target/` and ticket scratch dirs):

1. **`🧰️framework/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs`** (crate `semio-framework-core`, nx target `@semio-tech/framework-core-rs`) — the ONE real, active ts-rs driver in the repo. `📜️script.ts` (`generatedManifestPath()`, `runTypegenExportTest()`, `buildManifest()`) runs `cargo test --features typegen exports_typescript_bindings`, collects ts-rs's per-type `bindings/*.ts` output, consolidates it, and writes `join(root, "..", "🟦️typescript", "generated", "manifest.ts")` — i.e. the OLD `⚡️implementations/<lang>` sandwich sibling path. Sole consumer: `🧰️framework/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/📦️index.ts` imports `from "./generated/manifest.ts"` (relative, same sandwich).
   - **This crate has NOT moved to the new `📦️packages/<lang>` shape.** Verified on disk: `🧰️framework/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/` still holds `Cargo.toml`/`📋️project.json`/`📜️script.ts`/`📦️lib.rs` directly; there is no `🧰️framework/📦️packages` directory anywhere yet (`find` confirms zero matches). Framework consolidation is wave W8 in the approved plan and per `📋️master.md` has not started — only the plugin fan-out (W1/W2, all 32 plugins + demonstrator) is done so far. Per the ticket's own explicit instruction, this crate is therefore **out of scope for this ticket** — retargeting its driver now would mean guessing at a `<owner-root>` that doesn't exist yet (exactly the "silent type drift" risk the plan warns about).
2. **`🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🖱️ui/📦️packages/🦀️rust/🎯️targets/🧊️wgpu/📦️lib.rs`** (crate `semio-framework-ui-wgpu`, nx target `@semio-tech/ui-wgpu-rs`) — the only OTHER site with real `#[cfg_attr(feature = "typegen", derive(ts_rs::TS))]` annotations (~90 occurrences), and it HAS already moved to the new `📦️packages/🦀️rust` shape. But verified this feature is **completely dormant**: no `exports_typescript_bindings`-style test exists anywhere in its 17,881-line `📦️lib.rs` (searched for `TS::export`, `.export(`, `export_all`, `fn exports`, `cfg(all(test` combined with the typegen feature — zero hits), its `build.rs` only does UI-axes JSON→Rust/TS codegen (unrelated hand-written generator, not ts-rs), and its `📋️project.json`'s `generate`/`check` targets both route to that same UI-axes generator, not to any ts-rs export driver. Ran `bun ./📜️script.ts check` directly in that crate's dir (bypassing an unrelated broken nx graph, see below) — confirms "ui axes are fresh", i.e. the ONLY generator this crate's check target actually verifies has nothing to do with ts-rs. Cargo.toml's own comment even says the typegen feature exists for a FUTURE mirror ("see framework/core's former `typegen` feature") that hasn't been wired up here yet. **There is no driver output path here to retarget — there is no driver at all**, just inert derive annotations behind an optional feature nothing turns on today.
3. **`✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌊️flow/🧩️extensions/🏗️bim/📦️packages/🦀️rust/Cargo.toml`** — declares `ts-rs = "10"` as a dependency but the crate's `📦️lib.rs` (761 lines) never references `ts_rs`/`derive(TS)`/`export_to` anywhere. Dead/unused dependency declaration, not a codegen site.
4. **No plugin crate uses ts-rs at all** — confirmed via `grep -rln "ts-rs\|ts_rs" ✏️s/🔌️plugins --include=Cargo.toml --include=*.rs` returning only the flow-bim dead dependency above. Consistent with the plan's own prediction ("most plugin crates likely don't use ts-rs directly").
5. Root `Cargo.toml` line 261 lists `ts-rs = "10"` under `[workspace.dependencies]` (available for any crate to opt into via `workspace = true`) — not itself a codegen site, not touched.

**Conclusion — matches the ticket's own explicit fallback instruction**: no crate in the repo today satisfies BOTH conditions required for this ticket's action (uses a real ts-rs export driver/build.rs AND has already moved to the new `📦️packages/<lang>` shape). The one crate with a working driver (framework-core) is still old-shape; the one crate already in new-shape (ui-wgpu) has no working driver. **Zero files changed.** Deferring the framework-core-rs retarget to whenever W8 (framework consolidation) actually relocates that crate — at that point `generatedManifestPath()` in its `📜️script.ts` and the `framework-core-rs:check`/`:generate` targets should be updated in the SAME commit as the relocation, per the plan's own "must land with the driver change" risk note. If/when ui-wgpu's typegen feature is ever wired up with a real export test, its output path should go straight to `<owner-root>/🤖️generated/🟦️manifest.ts` from day one (no retrofit needed there since it'd be new code, not existing code to retarget).

**Unrelated blocker observed, NOT fixed (out of scope, another session's in-flight work)**: `bun nx run @semio-tech/ui-wgpu-rs:check` fails before even reaching the target — nx's project graph currently hard-fails repo-wide with "The following projects are defined in multiple locations: os-hub: 🌎️hub/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust, 🌎️hub/📦️packages/🦀️rust". This is `📋️master.md`'s "W8a hub dress rehearsal" migration caught mid-flight (dual old+new registration), not caused by anything here, and not touched — worked around it by invoking `bun ./📜️script.ts check` directly inside the ui-wgpu crate's own directory instead of through nx, a safe, non-destructive, read-only way to verify a single target when the graph is red. Flagging so whoever is running the hub migration (or the next registrar pass) knows the nx graph is currently broken repo-wide until that dual-registration resolves.

**Verification performed**: repo-wide grep sweeps (3 variants: derive(TS)/export_to across *.rs, ts-rs/ts_rs across Cargo.toml, build.rs scan) with /target/ and ticket-scratch dirs excluded; read both `📜️script.ts` drivers in full; read `ui-wgpu`'s Cargo.toml, build.rs, and project.json in full; confirmed `🧰️framework/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/` has no sibling `📦️packages` dir on disk; ran `ui-wgpu-rs`'s `check` target directly (green — "ui axes are fresh (2 locales, 2 terminologies)", confirming it exercises the UI-axes generator only, unrelated to ts-rs). No cargo/test commands were run against framework-core (would require a long `cargo test --features typegen` compile of an unrelated, untouched, out-of-scope crate — not needed since nothing there changed).

**Files touched: none — this is a pure investigation-and-defer outcome.** The paths below are files read/inspected as evidence for this determination, not modified.
